samples.source: Some may argue that given the part of the kernel that I'm best known for, I shouldn't be saying things like that. But on the other hand, when Jack and I first came up with this, it allowed him to drop 16,000 lines of really difficult buggy-prone code on the floor. So in some situations it does have some serious ease of use advantages.
